description:
Join us for New York Cities #1 Halloween Bar Fest hosted by BRIANNA CHICKENFRY!

One ticket grants access to 30+ participating bars and clubs. Check in at your selected venue to receive your official event wristband, then spend the day exploring New York City’s largest Halloween event!

Follow us on Instagram **@downtownbarfest** for updates and important event information leading up to the bar fest!

---

**HOW IT WORKS**

Check in at the venue you purchased a ticket for and receive your official Downtown Halloween Bar Fest wristband. This wristband will grant you access to all participating venues and exclusive drink specials throughout the event.

- Please note that all venues operate on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to capacity restrictions. We strongly recommend arriving before 2:00 PM to avoid long wait times.

  ---

**IMPORTANT INFORMATION**

- This event is strictly 21+.

- A valid government-issued photo ID is required for entry.

- Wristbands must be worn at all times and are non-transferable.

- Entry to venues is subject to each venue's capacity and discretion.

- The event takes place rain or shine.

- **ALL SALES ARE FINAL. NO REFUNDS OR EXCHANGES.**

- **COSTUMES ENCOURAGED!**

  ---

**PARTICIPATING VENUES**

**Lower East Side / East Village:**\
Ms. Yoo, Fool's Gold, Public Hotel, Ding-A-Ling, 82 Stanton, 310 Bowery, Grey Lady, Hotel Chantelle, Hair of the Dog, The DL, The Delancey, Arlene's Grocery, La Caverna, Jack Daw, One and One, Virgo.

**Kips Bay / Murray Hill:**\
Gem Saloon, Tara Rose, Blue Haven East, and Bella Union.

---

**QUESTIONS?**

For questions regarding tickets, sponsorships, partnerships, group sales, or general event information, please email:\
**nikki@tmmlpresents.com** **CC: tommy@tmmlpresents.com**

We Belong Here is a community connected through a shared passion for music, nature, history, dance, and culture.

Our events are sophisticated experiences curated only in unique settings. From landmark architecture to beautiful beaches and beyond, you can expect to dance to globally influenced, feel-good music curated by talented DJs and live performances. We forgo the usage of LED Screens in favor of immersive decorative lighting complementary to the venue space, and reduce capacity to ensure a comfortable dance floor.

Our mission is to create inclusive and extravagant moments where music lovers, globally refined party goers, and those simply looking for a positive nightlife/social experience can unite to experience the profound impact of a music community. This is a place to celebrate, heal, and connect - a place where your true self belongs.

Furthermore, we hope our community can provide a platform for creatives to pursue their passions and dreams. From supporting local talent at an unprecedented rate, and donating a portion of profits to support local music education - this is just the beginning of how together we make a small but precise and significant impact.

To learn more about We Belong Here find out about our future events, and see how you can get involved:

[www.webelonghere.world](http://www.webelonghere.world/)

We Belong Here experiences are for mature attendees who will show respect to the historic venues we have the honor of working with, and especially to other attendees.

For the safety, comfort and enjoyment of all, a strict consent policy is enforced for all social interactions. No means no, and anything other than yes means no.

Where we dance because it was nature's intention

Where we connect because we have more in common

Where we celebrate because tomorrow is not promised

Where we belong to something greater than ourselves

We Belong Here

Nocturnal Creature Society returns to Brooklyn.

“PRESSURE CHAMBER” is an all night descent into hard groove, hardcore, gabber, industrial techno and the heavier edges of New York’s underground.

indoor / outdoor venue. raw concrete, low ceilings, dark corners so sit and relax and a room built to feel completely consumed by sound.

No spectacle around a DJ booth. No chasing whatever sound is popular this month. This is music built for physical release.

NCS has always existed for the creatures who never quite belonged anywhere else. Queer kids. Ravers. Artists. Freaks. Hardcore heads. People who come to dance and search for community.

There are a thousand things calling themselves raves right now. Once you dance with the creatures, you know the difference.

OCTOBER 2\
BROOKLYN, NEW YORK\
SECRET LOCATION

Location released to ticket holders day of.

Come ready to sweat.

Come ready to dance.

BRING YOUR HARD HATS.

LIMITED CAPACITY\
COME FOR THE MUSIC STAY FOR THE COMMUNITY!

18+ to enter • ALL SALES ARE FINAL •

**Ncs aims to provide a safe environment**...

If you encounter any unwelcoming attention, malicious contact, bullying, harassment, or other behavior that makes you feel uncomfortable, please inform our staff promptly.

We are prepared to address and remove individuals involved in:

- Sexual harassment
- Aggression
- Violence
- Hatred or discrimination in any form

Your enjoyment is our top priority; if you have a good time, then we have a good time!

**DOOR POLICY**\
To help us curate a truly safe space and high energy dancefloor:\
• Admittance will be determined at the door. Tickets do not guarantee entry.\
• Our team reserves the right to deny entry at their discretion to protect the vibe, energy, and safety of the space.

our door policy isn’t about exclusivity, appearances, or hotness.\
It’s about protecting the space the energy, the people, and the experience we’re all here to create together.

We want every Creature who enters to **feel safe, free, and respected**.\
That means making sure no one who comes in is behaving in ways that could harm or disrupt that - things like being intoxicated, aggressive, disrespectful, homophobic, transphobic, or destructive.

Our team reserves the right to deny entry if someone’s energy, behavior, or state might compromise that environment. **It’s not personal**! it’s for the collective safety, and comfort of everyone inside.

Just because you’re not admitted one time doesn’t mean you’re not welcome in the future. We invite everyone to learn, grow, and come back when the vibe aligns.
